It seems like a connection occurs only when there are enough repeated occurrences, perhaps a threshold of three or more? Col14 also shows many gaps, even with frequent marks. I’m realizing that filling may depend on consecutive marks across gaps, so I need to clarify the criteria for those fills!

    return out
